parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma rolled a 7. This is my chance to get the robber off my Wheat 9. Claude is the one who put it there and he's sitting on a lot of resources (6 cards). I need to make sure Gemma realizes Claude is the bigger threat right now with his Ore/Wheat setup and those 6 cards in hand. If she hits him, it helps both of us.
parsed.note_to_self: Gemma rolled a 7. Robber is currently on Hex 14 (Wheat 9), blocking both my settlements. Claude has 6 cards (3 Wheat, 1 Ore, 1 Brick, 1 Sheep). Gemma has 2 Sheep. I need to encourage her to block Claude's Ore 5 or Wheat 6/9 to slow him down and free my production.
